## Context / Problem
Fixture setup is 47% of the `tests/interfaces` tier wall-clock (serial run: 361.4s setup vs 391.0s call, 1385 tests, 261 ms/test). The cause is `rebar_repo` (tests/interfaces/conftest.py:36), function-scoped, running mkdir + `git init` + 2x `git config` + `rebar.init_repo()` + `git commit --allow-empty` per test: 306 ms and 58 git process spawns (`init_repo` alone is 268 ms / 54 spawns). 589 test functions request it. The tier is spawn-bound (`sys` 335s > `user` 218s).

The macOS pytest cell is the Verified gate critical path (~18.6m) and holds one of only 5 org-wide macOS runner slots, so shortening it helps twice.

## Approach
Build the initialized repo ONCE per xdist worker (session-scoped, via `tmp_path_factory` so each worker gets its own basetemp — NEVER a fixed path like /tmp/rebar-template), then give each test a `shutil.copytree(symlinks=True)` copy. Measured 306 ms -> 22.3 ms (13.7x).

A copy needs four fix-ups, each closing a distinct sharing axis:

1. WORKTREE POINTERS. `init_repo` makes the store a git LINKED WORKTREE; two files embed the template's absolute path — `.tickets-tracker/.git` and `.git/worktrees/-tickets-tracker/gitdir`. Both must be rewritten against the REALPATH-resolved template path (macOS reports `/private/...`). A bare `git worktree repair` is a silent NO-OP here: it validates by path existence and the template still exists, leaving the copy on the TEMPLATE's object store and `refs/heads/tickets` — a write in the copy then advances the template's ref, invisible to `rebar list` (which reads worktree FILES, not refs).

2. GATE SNAPSHOT STORE. `src/rebar/_snapshot/repo_snapshot.py:134` keys the shared snapshot store by COMMIT SHA ALONE (tickets twin at `:635`), and tests/conftest.py forces `source=attested`/`ref=HEAD` for every test. One template = one SHA, so ~150 gate-touching tests would share one entry and "did the gate materialize MY repo?" becomes unfalsifiable; the LRU janitor can also evict mid-session and workers serialize on `locks/<sha>.lock`. Set `REBAR_GATE_TMPDIR` per test. (This also fixes a latent same-second SHA collision that exists TODAY.)

3. ENVIRONMENT IDENTITY. `.env-id` and `.signing-key` are `uuid4`s minted once at init (src/rebar/_commands/init.py:574-590), gitignored, so `copytree` carries them verbatim and they become worker-wide constants. No test goes false-green today, but "a signature only certifies in the environment that minted it" would stop being enforced by construction. Re-randomize both after each copy.

4. TEMPLATE BUILD ENVIRONMENT. A session fixture cannot request function-scoped `monkeypatch` and materializes lazily inside whichever test asks first — whose autouse env is live, and which varies per worker per run under `--dist worksteal`. Build the template inside an explicit `pytest.MonkeyPatch.context()` pinning `REBAR_ROOT`, setting `XDG_CONFIG_HOME` to an empty dir, deleting `REBAR_TRACKER_DIR`/`REBAR_TRACKER_BRANCH`/`REBAR_CONFIG`, with a config-cache reset on entry and exit.

Rejected: bare `git worktree repair` (proven no-op). Rejected: a shared session repo with no copy (destroys isolation). Rejected: migrating the ~20 module-local fixtures in this change (deferred; they are the larger remaining win).

## Scope
- `tests/interfaces/conftest.py` — session template fixture; a single `_clone_template` helper (ONE place the fix-up can be wrong); `rebar_repo` rewritten to copy + fix + re-randomize + set `REBAR_GATE_TMPDIR`. Also correct the wrong `tmp_path: pytest.TempPathFactory` annotation at :37.
- `tests/interfaces/conftest.py` — an AUTOUSE, TIER-WIDE guard (not fixture-local): for any test whose `REBAR_ROOT` holds a `.tickets-tracker` linked worktree, every path in `git worktree list --porcelain` must resolve inside `REBAR_ROOT`. Tier-wide so it also covers the ~20 deferred module-local fixtures and any fixture written later.
- `tests/interfaces/test_rebar_repo_isolation.py` — NEW durable sentinel tests (below).

### Why the guard is `worktree list`, not `--git-common-dir`
MEASURED: on a copy where ONLY `.tickets-tracker/.git` was rewritten and `gitdir` left stale, `rev-parse --git-common-dir` returns the COPY's path (guard GREEN) while `git worktree list` still names the TEMPLATE. `--git-common-dir` derives from the `.git` file alone and structurally cannot witness a stale `gitdir`. A `--git-common-dir` guard is therefore green-while-broken and must not be used.

### Residual coverage of the build-from-scratch path
Collapsing 589 incidental `init_repo` calls to one per worker removes INCIDENTAL coverage, so the deliberate coverage is named precisely:
- `tests/interfaces/store/test_init_idempotent_scratch.py` and `tests/interfaces/store/test_e4_init.py` DO call `init_repo` at runtime and must keep building from scratch, never from the template.
- `tests/unit/test_init_no_hardcoded_tracker.py` does NOT exercise the runtime path — it only walks the AST for hardcoded literals (zero `init_repo` calls, zero subprocesses). It is a static guard and must not be counted as runtime coverage.

## Testing
The sentinel must be a DURABLE checked-in test, not a one-time manual RED/GREEN observation, so the protection survives the merge and every later edit.

`tests/interfaces/test_rebar_repo_isolation.py` builds copies in-test and asserts:
- a copy with BOTH pointers rewritten passes the guard;
- a HALF-FIXED copy (only `.tickets-tracker/.git` rewritten, `gitdir` left stale) is REJECTED by the guard — this is the permanent proof that the guard is not the weaker `--git-common-dir` check;
- a copy fixed by a BARE `git worktree repair` is REJECTED;
- a write in one copy does not advance any other store's `refs/heads/tickets`, including the template's;
- no file under a copy contains the template path (generic catch for a THIRD pointer a future `init_repo` might add);
- the template is virgin: `rebar.list_tickets()` empty and `<repo>/.rebar/` absent (three tests assert emptiness that is currently guaranteed by construction — tests/interfaces/queries/test_recent_session_logs.py:84,:90 and tests/interfaces/lifecycle/test_session_log_capture.py:56 — so pre-warming the template must stay forbidden and enforced).

The existing 589 consumers are the regression suite and must pass unchanged.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] The tier-wide autouse guard rejects any store whose `git worktree list --porcelain` paths fall outside its own `REBAR_ROOT`.
- [ ] A checked-in test proves a HALF-FIXED copy (only `.tickets-tracker/.git` rewritten) is REJECTED by the guard.
- [ ] A checked-in test proves a copy fixed by bare `git worktree repair` is REJECTED.
- [ ] A checked-in test proves no file under a copy contains the template path.
- [ ] Writing a ticket in one `rebar_repo` does not advance any other store's `refs/heads/tickets`, including the template's.
- [ ] `rebar_repo` sets `REBAR_GATE_TMPDIR` to a per-test directory.
- [ ] `.env-id` and `.signing-key` differ between any two `rebar_repo` stores and from the template.
- [ ] The template fixture asserts it is virgin (no tickets, no `<repo>/.rebar/`).
- [ ] The template is created under `tmp_path_factory`, never a fixed filesystem path.
- [ ] `python -m pytest tests/interfaces -q` passes with the same collected/passed counts as before the change.
- [ ] `tests/interfaces/store/test_init_idempotent_scratch.py` and `tests/interfaces/store/test_e4_init.py` still build from scratch and pass.
- [ ] `make lint` and `make typecheck` pass.
